title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Letter Languages and Delivery Channel
content:
## Languages and channel of program letters

On every tier of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care; Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL); Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL); Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL); Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL); Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL) — the application, the plain-language summary and the letters are provided in English, Spanish and Hmong, and determination and missing-information letters are delivered by US mail.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Preferred languages in which the application, plain-language summary and letters are provided | English; Spanish; Hmong |
| Delivery channel of determination and missing-information letters | US mail |
